name: XTR direct-mount front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 117 g for the FD-M9000-D direct-mount 3×11-speed front derailleur, including its mounting bolt. The exact model column identifies Direct Mount and the weight heading specifies direct type with bolt. Clamp-band and E-type alternatives do not inherit this weight.
